table inet filter { # handle 1
	set allowed { # handle 4
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 10.0.0.1, 10.0.0.2 }
	}

	chain input { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		jump web # handle 5
	}

	chain web { # handle 2
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } ct state established,new counter accept comment "web # handle 99" # handle 7
		ip saddr @allowed tcp dport 22 accept # handle 8
		quota 10 mbytes accept # handle 9
	}

	chain empty { # handle 3
	}
}
